F16.title: Validated inline fix suggestions: projected candidates, gated, checked on the head tree, posted as one review comment

items.item: projection, not invention (§5, §7.1): a suggestion is a projection of an existing validated candidate (candidate id and validation hash travel with the posting); without an eligible validated candidate the answer is "no validated fix is available" — CIE never invents one; the host installs a CandidateProvider on the public engine slot

the service hook prepares through a provider and reports an honest publish failure

items.item: eligibility gate (§7.2): base==head; a single file and a single hunk within maxLines; never T2 paths (auth/session/secret, dependency manifests, CI workflows); the quoted bytes must still sit at the recorded range on the head tree; no test-file edits without the preserved-oracle declaration; no create/rename/delete; the forge anchor range (F19 seam); denied paths are counted, never named
tests: F16-A1: a candidate whose base is not the PR head is ineligible, rule named
F16-A2: multi-hunk, multi-file, file-creating, file-deleting and test-editing candidates are ineligible with a named reason
F16-A3: a T2 path (auth, dependency, workflow) is ineligible with the pattern named
F16-A4: the posted text is byte-identical to the validated replacement; a mutated replacement is rejected before posting
F16-A12: a denied path is never suggested and is not named

items.item: validation on the head tree (§7.3, §13): the candidate edit applies byte-exact in a scratch copy (stale check); a type-check runs against the head baseline; tests run when a runner exists; the detector re-checks the patched tree (finding gone, no new findings); a check that cannot run is recorded NOT_RUN and mandatory checks not run make the suggestion non-postable — never simulated
tests: F16-A6: new type diagnostics or a failing test stop the suggestion
F16-A7: a finding still present (or a new one introduced) on re-analysis stops the suggestion
F16-A8: NOT_RUN checks appear under "Not checked"; mandatory checks not run block posting
the default validator runs type-check and finding re-analysis on a scratch copy of the head

items.item: rendering (§7.4): the suggestion block is generated from the validated replacement bytes, fenced longer than any backtick run in the replacement; the body lists the checks that ran, a "Not checked" line, and the fixed caveat "This is a suggestion; applying it is your decision."; copy never says fixes/resolves/safe/verified without a scope phrase
tests: F16-A5: a replacement containing triple and quadruple backticks renders without breaking the fence
F16-A4: the posted text is byte-identical to the validated replacement; a mutated replacement is rejected before posting

items.item: posting (§7.5, §8): one review event of type COMMENT — never approve/request-changes; per-PR cap of three posted suggestions, the rest listed in one line; grant-checked immediately before and after the external call; a public forge destination may not receive text while the analysis scope is narrower (D8)

F16-A14: the per-PR cap of three holds; the rest are listed in one line

items.item: observation (§7.6, §9, §11): on the next analysed head a POSTED suggestion becomes APPLIED when the head tree holds the replacement, otherwise SUPERSEDED in place keeping the history visible; a PREPARED suggestion on a moved head is superseded, never posted; observations never feed ranking; a suggestion prepared against a stale head is refused by the publisher's own head check
tests: F16-A10: a push marks the suggestion superseded in place; a suggestion for a stale head is never posted
F16-A15: an applied suggestion is observed on the next head and recorded APPLIED; it does not alter ranking

items.item: idempotency and egress (§10.3, §11, §14): one posting per (finding, head, replacement) — re-preparation is identity; publish is find-before-create by marker so a crash after posting adopts the landed comment instead of duplicating it, and the publication receipt is kept single; a secret-like replacement makes the posting refuse, unaltered; a finding not introduced by the PR (D4) is never suggestible
